'''Morn Meebler''' was a field producer for the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] program ''[[Wild, Wild Galaxy]]''. Meebler worked for the [[HoloNet Broadcasting Service]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Morn Meebler searched for a group of seasoned hunters for the show's next season. The hunters had to defend settlements from vicious migrating creatures, filmed by Meebler's remote-controlled [[Cam droid/Legends|hovercams]].<ref name="SWG:HSoOM" />
